_comment: Copy to .cursor/mcp.json (gitignored). vexlum is the single backend entry point: search -> resolve -> execute over Python tools, REST API (api.*), PostgreSQL (db.*) and browser (browser.*). Replaces is-be-mcp / is-be-live (deprecated). Build: cd mcp-server && npm ci && npm run build. Docs: docs/technical/VEXLUM_MCP.md.

vexlum._comment: Destructive actions (db.execute, DELETE API, prune, ...) also need env VEXLUM_ALLOW_ELEVATED=1 here.

fff-be._comment: Fast file search — must launch inside a git repo (not user home or FS root). Install: see AGENTS.md § fff.

graphify-be._comment: Optional — requires graphify-mcp on PATH (uv tool install "graphifyy[mcp]") and graphify-out/graph.json (graphify . --code-only). Soft; see AGENTS.md § Graphify and .cursor/skills/graphify/SKILL.md.
